observations.content:
Summary: The Burj Khalifa's official height is 828 metres (2,716.5 ft), according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat, Guinness World Records, and multiple sources including Wikipedia and SkyscraperDay. The building, developed by Emaar Properties, is the world's tallest structure, surpassing Taipei 101. The sources also mention the building's total height, which includes an antenna spire, reaching 829.8 metres (2,722 ft).

[1] 'Burj Khalifa' is Unveiled to the World and its Official Height is 828 Metres
    https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/burj-khalifa-is-unveiled-to-the-world-and-its-official-height-is-828-metres-80657972.html
    (Photo:  )

The official height of the tower, unveiled as 'Burj Khalifa', was announced as 828 metres (2,716.5 ft).

'Burj Khalifa', developed by Emaar Properties (), is the world's tallest building according to the three criteria of the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat: 'Height to Architectural Top', 'Height To Highest Occupied Floor', and 'Height To Tip'. [...] The tower is 320 metres taller than  Taiwan's   Taipei  101, which had held the title of world's tallest building since 2004, the year when the project was announced.

Mohamed Alabbar, Chairman of Emaar Properties, said that the tower represented a symbol of hope to the Arab world and a shining example of human achievement. [...] "Thousands of people from more than 100 countries have contributed to the realisation of 'Burj Khalifa'. The tower embodies the spirit and optimism of global collaboration, and shows to the world what can be achieved when communities work in partnership."

A dramatic sound, light, firework and fountain display described the evolution of the tower, and ended in a breathtaking climax of lasers and fireworks, bathing the tower and the surrounding area in white light.

args.query: Shanghai Tower height 632 meters CTBUH official height

observations.content:
Summary: According to the sources, Shanghai Tower stands at 632 meters (2,073 feet) tall, making it the tallest building in China and the world’s third tallest by architectural height as of 2025, according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH). It was the second tallest globally from its opening in 2015 until 2021, when it was surpassed by Merdeka 118 in Malaysia. The Shanghai Tower is designed by Gensler and features a distinctive 120-degree twist from base to top, with a transparent outer facade creating dramatic double-skin construction for energy efficiency.
